name: restock
description: A merchant shopping list built with React, Express, TypeScript and MongoDB
author: @bennobuilder

scripts.clean: turbo run clean --force && shx rm -rf .turbo && shx rm -rf node_modules
scripts.install:clean: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.update:latest: turbo run update:latest --force --concurrency=1 && pnpm update --latest '!typescript' && pnpm build
